topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't help but think about what it means, you know? When someone who was such a big part of your childhood just... doesn't remember. We spent so much time together, built so many castles and forts, shared so many secrets. It's strange to think that all those moments, which are so vivid to me, might be lost to them. I tried not to let it show when we talked, didn't want to make things awkward. Maybe it's just a lot to process on my end. I guess what I'm wondering is, do you think it's possible to reconnect, to maybe share those stories and spark some memories? Or should I just... move on?
